errors.description: The interior waistband curtain and the fly facing are rendered in a contrast ecru pocketing cloth, whereas the illustration draws every interior panel unshaded (i.e. no contrast indicated).
errors.expected: Interior panels unshaded in the drawing; no contrast called for.
errors.actual: Ecru curtain/facing contrasting against the navy suiting.
errors.correction: Acceptable natural interior tailoring cloth; would ideally be tonal. Not a construction error and does not affect the option's readability.

errors.description: The model's bare torso is visible above the waistband, adding a small amount of non-garment content to the top of the frame.
errors.expected: Documentation crop confined to the garment.
errors.actual: Roughly the top 10% of frame is bare skin.
errors.correction: Tighten the top edge to the waistband seam so no skin above the waistband is in frame.

notes: Absence option. The illustration is an interior construction view of the trouser front: waistband with belt loops across the top, centre fly with a zip, and two pocket bags pulled out and hanging over the leg fronts, with no coin pocket anywhere. The candidate reproduces exactly that face: interior waistband, open fly with zip and shield, and both pocket bags hanging free with the same curved lower-outer corner as drawn. Critically, no coin pocket has been hallucinated in — the clean, unbroken area under the waistband is the subject and reads within a second. Symmetry between left and right bags matches the drawing. Two minor findings only, both cosmetic.
